audit: P10-WP1 three-profile port parity (ADR-048 O-03, DB-002, DB-008)

profiles.name: embedded
profiles.evidence: profile_a_serves_every_port_it_declares runs one shared contract over metadata CAS + revisioned read + typed key equality, the durable outbox, full text, vector profile isolation and immutable artifacts, and reloads the store to prove durability at flush
limits: single process, single writer; no cross-process locking
full text and vector are derived projections: they are rebuilt from canonical data plus outbox replay
durability is obtained at flush(), not per mutation
